resource.description: Draft FHIR R4 order-set PlanDefinition based on the items listed on the SIMS Hospitals Diabetic Health Screening Package page. This is a package representation, not a clinically validated protocol. Validate the complete order set, eligibility, sex-specific screening, conditional tests, and sequencing with the hospital before production use.
